name: Silverdale
areaNote: South end of the Maple Ridge / Mission border
blurb: On the south end of the Maple Ridge / Mission border. The Silverdale Doggy Vacation Lodge: 5 acres with 3 acres of outdoor yards, a 4,000 sq ft covered arena and a water park. Home of our Maple Ridge / Mission group classes.

team.name: Brooke
team.bio: Brooke has worked professionally with dogs for over 8 years and has owned dogs her whole life. She is a huge advocate for ongoing education, having completed Dog Handler Academy certification and Dog Facility conferences in the States. In her spare time she enjoys going for walks with her own dogs Sam (4 year old Golden cross) and Cooper (8 year old Shepherd cross), plus doing art, camping, kayaking and taking out the quad.

team.name: Morgan
team.bio: Morgan’s true passion is working with dogs and she loves making owners feel comfortable with leaving dogs in our care. She brings 6+ years of dog industry experience to our team and her goal is to become a Dog Trainer for the Silverdale facility. She owns 2 dogs, Levi (Border Collie cross) and Georgia (St. Bernard cross), and is always trying new enrichment activities and obedience training for them. Morgan loves camping and hiking with her dogs (rain or shine), and she enjoys balancing outdoor activity with a good snuggle or movie on the couch.

team.name: Natalie
team.bio: Natalie has worked in the dog industry for over 3 years and bring an additional 7 years of retail management experience to our team. She loves building bonds with customers and their pups so they know that they are in safe hands when coming to Silverdale. Natalie is Dog Handler Academy certified and her goals include expanding knowledge through dog behaviour, training and medical courses. Outside of work she loves taking care of her kitty who has a heart condition and spending time with family & friends.

team.name: Taylor
team.bio: Taylor loves dogs and has always dreamt of working with them and being able to care for them. She especially enjoys meeting new dogs and getting to know their different personalities and traits. Taylor owns a 4 year old Pug named Avery and her hobbies include hiking, traveling, watercolour & graphic art.

team.name: Brodee
team.bio: Brodee loves dogs and has been working full time at Silverdale Doggy Vacation Lodge since 2023. He is a self-motivated, quick learner and has completed Dog Handler Academy certification plus ongoing personal education on dog body language, dog training and behaviour. A few of his favourite reads are: The Dog’s Mind and The Forever Dog. Brodee has a special interest in canine first aid, health and grooming (having apprenticed for 6 months with a Groomer) and he does a fantastic job performing daily health checks on our pups. Some of his hobbies include playing the piano, reading and jogging.

team.name: Ali
team.bio: Ali has spent most of her life working with hourses, including competing in local hunter/jumper and dressage shows. While horses were her main focus for 15 years, Ali always made time to play with the barn dogs. Ali spends her free time practicing obedience and agility with her Cocker Spaniel cross named Barrie.

team.name: Hannah
team.bio: Hannah has worked at Obedience Unleashed for 6 years as a Dog trainer and Senior Assistant at our Daycare/Boarding/Training facility. She brings rich multidisciplinary experience from her 8 years competing in 4H with dogs & llamas and 5 years as a professional handler for CKC show dogs competing in obedience, agility, conformation, and rally-obedience. She has earned her Excellent title in rally-obedience and is working toward her Master’s title with her current dog Oakley.

team.name: Melissa B.
team.bio: Melissa has a Bachelor’s Degree in Archaeology with a specialization in Forensics and enjoyed a successful 15 year career in Sales & Customer Service before deciding to become a Professional Dog Trainer in 2021. She brings 17 years of animal training and competition experience with horses in dressage. She grew up with dogs, has done agility training and earned Canine Good Citizen & Canine Good Neighbour titles. She currently competes actively with her dog Luna and most recently earned her novice and intermediate titles in rally-obedience.

team.name: Kim
team.bio: Kim has worked as a Dog Trainer since 2020 and joined the Obedience Unleashed Team in 2022. She brings 7 years of experience in the Hospitality Industry and is enthusiastic about connecting with dog owners to really listen to their needs and tailor training for their dogs. At home you can find her practicing Agility with her Lab Maya or working in Rally-Obedience with her Belgian Malinois Luca.
